reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the range and missing-amount rules used elsewhere.

duplication.why: No rule logic is restated; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: Added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that maps internal schedules to API shapes, with the handler type updated in api-handlers.ts.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and rule-consistent; toExternal now always returns the list type with a read-only field, which slightly blurs the split the new type comment describes.
